text:
sasha: Heads up — Support reports mass deprovisions for tenant acme-corp around 02:57Z. ~120 accounts removed. Anyone on call?
ops-bot: Incident opened: INC-2026-204 - SCIM mass deprovision (P1) 
priyam: digging into provisioner logs (scim-provisioner-1). lots of decrypt failures: ```
2026-03-23T02:57:11Z scim-provisioner-1 ERROR deprovision user=usr_123 err="kms:Decrypt NotFound alias=alias/provisioning-2026-03-23"
2026-03-23T02:57:12Z scim-provisioner-1 WARN reconcile user=usr_456 external_id_lookup=miss
```
leo: I paused deprov workers: `scimctl workers pause --queue deprovision --env prod` — new deprovs stopped, in-flight will finish. :white_check_mark: 
priyam: quick correlation: RBAC migration deployed 02:51Z (service rbac-core) that normalized role strings and ran a rewrite job with `--apply` flag. migration logs show a join failure that excluded external_id column from the subject rewrite set. So downstream mapping now returns nil extid for many subjects.
keyops: Checked KMS history: alias `alias/provisioning-2026-03-23` was rotated at 02:50Z to key-789. Previous key key-456 is still present but scheduled for auto-delete in 7 days (tombstone flag=false). We can re-point alias back to key-456 if needed.
audit-bot: Audit ingestion shows only a handful of scim.deprovision events in the window (4) — mismatch vs support numbers. Raw kafka topic `audit-raw` still has ~120 deprov messages; ingestion filter likely dropped them because of a schema change. I'll backfill those into warehouse.
sasha: TL;DR: two things happened close together: role rewrite removed extid mapping, KMS alias rotation changed key that provisioner used to decrypt stored extid blobs. Combined -> provisioner thinks subjects are unknown -> deprov.
priyam: Mitigation options (ordered):
1) re-point KMS alias to previous key (fast, minimal code change)
2) re-run RBAC rewrite with `--include-external_id --dry-run` then `--apply` if validated
3) run a targeted remap using backup mapping in S3 to repopulate external_id column, then reconcile SCIM for affected tenants
4) if nothing else, emergency customer rollback and manual user re-provision (last resort)

I'm leaning to option 1 then 2. We'll test alias re-point in staging first.
leo: Agreed. I've notified Support and scheduled a 30-min maintenance window if we do prod alias re-point. Also prepared a targeted reconcile command: `scimctl reconcile --tenant acme-corp --users-file /tmp/acme-affected.csv --commit` (dry-run available).
keyops: I can re-point alias in ~10m but need explicit go from eng-svc lead. Note: re-pointing does not restore any extid values that were overwritten by the RBAC job. It only makes existing encrypted blobs decryptable again.
audit-bot: Starting backfill now and will attach the extracted events to the incident for customer comms.
sasha: Assigning owners: @priyam -> orchestration + staging validation for alias rollback, @keyops -> alias re-point, @leo -> support comms + reconcile ops, @audit-bot -> backfill & attach. Please post status updates here.
priyam: Running staging rehearse: re-point alias -> restart scim-provisioner -> run `scimctl reconcile --tenant acme-corp --mode dry-run`. Posting output in 15m.
sasha: One note for postmortem: add a preflight check to RBAC rewrites that ensures `external_id` is in the rewrite set when role rewrites are enabled. Also add a KMS alias lockstep checklist when doing simultaneous key rotations and data migrations.
leo: Also start drafting customers notes: what happened, mitigation, timeline, and next steps (manual restore options). I'll loop legal for potential compliance notification.
ops-bot: Incident status: P1 -> active -> mitigation in progress. Next update in 20m.
priyam: staging dry-run succeeded: extid blobs decrypt after alias re-point, reconcile dry-run shows 118 accounts would be preserved (no deprov). Preparing runbook for prod alias re-point + recon reconcile.
sasha: Good. Wait for keyops go ahead then execute with support on the line. Keep comms tight.
keyops: Giving go for alias re-point at 03:30Z. Will perform and announce when complete.
sasha: thx — update thread when alias swap done and if reconcile commit proceeds.
